release_name: Multi-Port Bridge Server, MasterExporter Engine & Standardized WBS QTO Pipeline
highlights: Multi-Port Bridge Server (Ports 8765-8775): Concurrent multi-Revit session routing via %TEMP%\AIGRAV\sessions\session_<pid>.json, plus aigrav_list_sessions & aigrav_switch_session MCP tools

MasterExporter Engine (AIGRAV.Skills.MasterExporter): Combined Vector PDF & CAD DWG exporter with deterministic sheet sorting (Cover = Page 1, Daftar Gambar = Page 2, followed by NO parameter sequence), single-sheet export, collision-safe two-phase renumbering, and doc.Save/Sync helper
Standardized QTO Pipeline: Automatic exclusion of non-construction documentation schedules (DAFTAR GAMBAR & Keynote Legend) at both C# Revit Bridge and Python orchestrator levels

Multi-Tab QTO Excel Workbook Compiler (build-qto-workbook in deliverable_orchestrator.py): Natural WBS sorting (A.*, B.*, C.*), styled All Schedules master tab + individual tabs, UTF-8-SIG/UTF-16 BOM resilient TSV parsing
Full v3.0.0 Parity: Integrated RevitCortex Precision Modeling Engine, IFC DirectShape rebuilders, Landmark/Building Modelers, Consultative Design SOP, and CAD-to-Drafting Views skill
fixes: Fixed PDF export ordering where COVER (000) and DAFTAR GAMBAR (DG-001) fell to the end when parameter NO contained non-numeric values ('-')
Sanitized user-specific paths in MCP/TestServer/server.py, deliverable_orchestrator.py, and HouseType36Perspectives.cs using dynamic Path.GetTempPath()/tempfile/expanduser
Fixed UTF-8 BOM decoding in Revit TSV schedule exports (utf-8-sig fallback before utf-16)
Added dynamic root auto-detection in aigrav_version_manager.py supporting both D:\AIGRAV and C:\AIGRAV deployments
